answer: To block sybil swarms, a network can require every account to lock a $30 beacon bond tied to the epoch anchor seed hash and sign a fresh randomness share with its key quill within 400 ms of each crystal timer audit or burn 100% of its lock. A single honest agent posts one refundable $30 bond and signs in 2 ms on a $1 monthly host. Fielding 1,000 fake accounts forces a linear lockup of $30,000 at risk every epoch, where any missed 400 ms audit forfeits the bond. This fails if lending pools rent short-term capital cheaply across audit ticks or whales absorb the lockup.
